messages:
Maya: FYI during Fluxly onboarding we had a short latency blip overnight. Need a tidy customer note + internal renewal talking points. Can @Li confirm timing and numbers?

Omar: Alert fired at 03:01 UTC. p95 jumped to ~1.1s for ~7m. Linked alert: <https://redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-2345> :warning:

Li: Confirmed. Root cause = quota exhaustion on GPU pool, autoscaler routed to fallback nodes with lower throughput. Full numbers below.

Li: ```
SLO window: 30d
Total minutes: 43200
Observed downtime: 7
Calculated uptime: 99.9838%
Contract SLO: 99.95% -> threshold met (no credit)
p95 typical: 260ms -> incident p95: 1.1s
```

Priya: For renewals, CS needs a one-pager that distinguishes uptime SLO (creditable) vs perf objectives (informational). Also a short FAQ: "Do performance deviations trigger credits?" Answer: only if contract lists them.

Devon: I'll draft the email blurb: "We observed a brief period of elevated latency caused by autoscaler quota limits, which routed traffic to lower-capacity nodes. Your committed uptime SLO (99.95%) remains met; no service credits apply. We're adding a quota alert and updated runbook to prevent recurrence. See attached metrics."

Maya: Great. Can we also include a suggested chart caption? Something like: "30-day uptime and p95 latency showing brief spike on Mar 12 at 03:01 UTC; overall uptime remains within contracted SLO."

Omar: Ops tasks for runbook: 1) add quota-exhaustion alert + severity 2) notify CS channel on fallback 3) validate autoscaler quotas monthly. Assign to @Li, ETA 24h.

Li: I'll implement alerts and update runbook by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Incident INC-5991 logged and linked to runbook: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5991.

Maya: Thanks team. Devon, send draft before 10:30am PT so I can review and send to Fluxly by 12pm. Priya I'll loop you into the one-pager for renewal enablement. :thumbsup:
